2026-09-28: two measured changes, both re-run with merge. (1) The per-school walk bounds were raised from 80 catalogue entries / 260 page fetches / 140 level probes to 200 / 600 / 400 after measuring the three schools the shallow walk still left open (work/programme-link-probe/27000-default.json, 27000-raised.json, muni-limits.json, muni-limits-2.json, muni-limits-3.json, 21000-default.json, 21000-raised.json): VSB went 147->230 of 293 in 262 requests, Masaryk 278->300 of 534 in 318, and CVUT 64->67; Masaryk at 500 entries and 624 requests resolved only two more, so 200 is where the walk stops paying. Merged runs: Masaryk 261->296, VSB 147->228. (2) Two schools got catalogue entry URLs that were measured first and adopted only on a verified gain: Panevropska msmt-vs_7s000 0->17 of 22 and AMBIS msmt-vs_61000 4->12 of 31. Two links were also lost on purpose: the resolver now drops a 200 answer that is a redirect stub (an empty <title> and <h1> with a body under 2 KiB), because the school's information system answers is.slu.cz/program/<id>/... and is.muni.cz/predmet/<id>/<CODE> that way and the page it means is never read. All five of Slezska univerzita's links and one of Masaryk's were stubs, so msmt-vs_19000 is revised 5->0 with that reason rather than being read as a crawler regression; a 0-byte answer is still only a transport failure and stays unverified. Total 3229->3365 (+136: 35 + 81 + 17 + 8 - 5), 626 of them page-title verified.

2026-09-28: two more schools got catalogue entry URLs that were measured offline before being written, and the floor also catches up on nine AMU links the previous run had already resolved. (1) UHK msmt-vs_18000 40->80 of 126: four per-faculty admission catalogue pages were added (pedagogicka, informatiky-a-managementu, filozoficka, prirodovedecka), measured offline at 45 of 126 distinct register rows (work/programme-link-probe/uhk-faculties.log, against 11 for the single university-level listing page the school was configured with before). The merged live run reached 80, above the offline measure, because the walk then reads one level deeper than the probe did. (2) VSCHT msmt-vs_22000 37->42 of 116, which is deliberately BELOW what the same offline measurement reported: the two listing pages bound 61 of 116 rows offline (work/programme-link-probe/uhk-vscht-catalogues.log), but that number is binding only, before any reachability check. In the live bounded run the school answered ten catalogue reads with 404, one with 403 and one with 500, and eight rows whose only candidate was one of those 404 pages went back to the university site, so 42 is what a page actually confirmed this run. The 19 offline rows the run did not reach are still unreachable, not lost: they stay in unresolved with reason no_candidate_page and the next run that reads those pages decides again. (3) AMU msmt-vs_51000 11->20 is not a new gain from this run: AMU resolved 20 on 2026-09-28T18:30:43Z and the floor was never re-baselined for it. AMU was in this run for regression protection only, after an earlier walk had displaced two proven DAMU pages with addresses that answered 404; it held at 20 with both proven pages kept, and gained nothing because no faculty sitemap entry was adopted for it. Total 3365->3419 (+54: 40 + 5 + 9). Of the 45 new links, 33 answered with a page title matching the register row. No previously committed id was lost and no row kept by an existing link changed address.

2026-09-28: AMU's three faculty sitemaps were adopted as catalogue entries, but only after measuring what they bind (work/programme-link-probe/amu-sitemap-baseline.json, amu-sitemap-variant.json, amu-final.json, live-amu-codestrip.log). Measured offline with previous={}: the entry URLs the school already had resolve 20 of 101 rows in 264 requests, and adding famu.cz/sitemap-programs.xml, hamu.cz/sitemap-programs.xml and damu.cz/sitemap-programs.xml on their own resolved the same 20 in 271 requests - every <loc> was fetched and none was bound, because each slug ends with the school's own programme code (animovana-tvorba-232) and so equalled no register title. The resolver now reads that code off a slug the way it already reads a code-shaped parenthetical off a catalogue anchor: the slug is taken exactly as the school wrote it whenever it already equals a register title, and only otherwise retried without a trailing two-to-four digit number. No register row ends in a two-to-four digit number, so removing one can only stop a real page from being read as naming nothing; it cannot move one row's page to another row. Measured again with that rule: 26 of 101 rows in 347 requests. The merged live run reached 27, one above the offline measure, and all seven new links answered verified with a page title equal to the register row: Directing of Devised and Object Theatre, Taneční umění a nonverbální divadlo, Produkce a management, PuppArts EMJM, Skladba a teorie skladby, Interpretace a teorie interpretace, Choreology. No previously committed id was lost, no row kept by an existing link changed address, and no other school was re-fetched. The rule is general but its measured gain is AMU's alone: reading each of the other 42 schools' sitemap roots twice, once with and once without the code-free reading, changed the titles bound for none of them (work/programme-link-probe/generality.log, generality-rest.log) - only AMU writes a code-shaped suffix onto every programme slug. AMU's other 74 unresolved rows did not improve: 54 are now ambiguous_register_rows rather than no_candidate_page, because the register holds those 26 titles at two levels and the programme pages state no level the resolver can read, and the level probe separated six of them. Those rows stay unresolved with the reason recorded rather than being bound by a guessed level.
